turns: What are the graduation requirements for my program?

conversation.user: What are the graduation requirements for my program?

payload.content: For undergraduate programs at UAEU (excluding the College of Medicine and Health Sciences), graduation requires completion of the approved degree structure with at least 120 semester credits, a cumulative GPA of at least 2.00, no outstanding Incomplete grades, and satisfaction of required components including general education, college requirements, major requirements, electives, minors, and exit proficiency. Program-specific requirements may also apply.

citations.title: UAEU Degree Completion and Graduation Procedures
citations.sourceVersion: Effective 2018-08-12; review due 2021-09-01; no supersession certification
citations.evidenceText: Published effective-2018 undergraduate policy excludes the College of Medicine and Health Sciences; later supersession not established. AE-06 procedure 2: complete approved degree structure, at least 120 semester credits, cumulative GPA at least 2.00 and no outstanding Incomplete (I); satisfy required general-education/college/major/elective/minor and exit-proficiency components. Program-specific structures may add requirements. CMHS is expressly excluded.
